item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00281","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C08","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 supplies a concrete, material drafting template: the child closely follows its single-sentence structure, tax-return enumeration, congressional-session limitation, authorization of inspection by a Senate committee or subcommittee, Treasury-decision condition, and Federal Register effectiveness clause. The principal substitutions are the covered years, committee, and investigative purpose. C08 is also highly similar and matches the Judiciary-committee target, while C02 is an earlier version of the same inspection-order machinery, but C05 is closest overall in operative language and structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1941 to 1951, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-second Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on the Judiciary or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess -profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1950 shall, during the Eighty-second Congress, be open to Inspection by the Senate Committee on Rules and Administration or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof","explanation":"The child preserves C05's distinctive enumeration and operative sequence while substituting the covered period and Senate committee."},{"child_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date","parent_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the Inspection of such returns by that committee, approved by me this date","explanation":"This administrative condition is reproduced essentially verbatim in the same position."},{"child_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.","explanation":"The child retains C05's concluding effectiveness provision verbatim apart from capitalization."}]}
